# @trysac/mermaid-check

> Browser-free linter for Mermaid diagrams in Markdown. It finds fenced diagrams, reports structural mistakes with line numbers (codes MMD001 to MMD008) and can call an external renderer. TypeScript library for Node.js 20+, published as ES modules with type declarations. MIT.

- [README](README.md): problem, installation, usage and API
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions and limits for contributors and agents
